resources.string: Allow this profile to contact the configured relay server? Shared content is encrypted, but the server can see connection addresses, package sizes and timing. Background delivery may be delayed. This does not allow automatic sharing of medical records. Previously received copies cannot be recalled.
Delivery is paused or waiting to retry. Check your connection and pilot access.

Enable sync on both phones. In partner settings, prepare an internet link and exchange the encrypted setup packets manually twice: first the connection certificates, then the delivery routes. Each phone must complete both exchanges. No medical records are shared by setup.
Choose what to share and with whom for each exchange. File sharing and manual Bluetooth exchange remain available.
Internet sync is not available yet
Automatic nearby exchange is not available. Bluetooth exchange starts only when you request it.
Internet sync was allowed for this profile, but internet delivery is not available in this version. You can withdraw that permission.
Up to 100 recent entries, with pending items first. An item in the queue has not necessarily been delivered.
No queued sends or receipts yet.
Revoking access stops future sharing. Turning off internet sync does not send a hidden request to the server.
Deleting queued packages from the relay server requires a separate confirmed request. Cancelling a send here does not confirm server deletion; server backups may also retain earlier copies.
A recipient may already have saved or exported a copy. Revoking access or deleting a relay package cannot guarantee erasure of information already received.

Stop future internet sharing and cancel local sends that have not been handed off? Your records, contacts and manual sharing will remain. This does not confirm deletion of any server or recipient copies.
Cancel this local send? The original message and manual sharing remain available. Copies already handed off cannot be recalled here.
Pause automatic record sharing with this recipient and cancel their local record queue? Your own records and manual sharing remain. Already handed-off copies are not recalled.
The contents are no longer available.
Waiting for internet delivery to become available
Too large for internet sync. Manual exchange is still available.
